message: The other day, I was in the kitchen whipping up dinner when I noticed my smoke alarm had a little flashing light—yep, it was time to replace the batteries. I felt a little proud, like I was finally the one who had their act together! So, I took a moment to double-check my escape plan with the family. Turns out, being prepared can feel pretty good. Have you checked your smoke alarms lately? 🔥
